messages.subject: s_ldsc not in current version of genomicSEM?
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to run s_ldsc on my common factor model. After updating GenomicSEM, when I run s_ldsc with the code from github, (code below) i get:
Error in s_ldsc(traits = traits, sample.prev = sample.prev, population.prev = population.prev,  : 
  could not find function "s_ldsc"

Here is what I ran
S_LDSCOutput<- s_ldsc(traits=traits,
                     sample.prev=sample.prev,
                     population.prev=population.prev ,
                     ld=ld,
                     wld=wld,
                     frq=frq,
                     trait.names = trait.names)
Alex
